page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7.16xlarge is a general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing Intel Xeon 8369B processors running at 2.7 GHz. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. There is no local storage bundled with this instance, and it does not include any GPUs. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 32 Gbps.

Benchmark data reveals strong multi-core performance, with the instance placing in the top 25% for stress-ng multi-core CPU, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU scores. It also demonstrates strong capabilities in multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, software compilation with Clang, ray tracing, and image processing. However, single-core performance is more moderate, with stress-ng single-core, Geekbench single-core, and single-threaded compression benchmarks falling into the average middle 50% range. Memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations also perform within average parameters.

Given its dedicated physical core allocation and strong multi-core execution, the ecs.g7.16xlarge offers high resource density for parallelized workloads. It is highly capable for database operations, static web serving, and small-scale LLM inference, where it achieves top-tier prompt processing and text generation speeds. The lack of local storage requires external block storage attachment, which represents a key architectural tradeoff. This instance is well-suited for multi-threaded enterprise applications, software compilation pipelines, and general-purpose workloads requiring dedicated compute resources without GPU acceleration.
